bogofilter_dir.description: Alternate value for the directory for wordlists. The default active setting in the source is ~/.bogofilter.

db_transaction.description: Boolean indicating whether database transactions should be enabled (yes) or disabled (no).

stats_in_header.description: Boolean (Yes/No/1/0) indicating whether to put spamicity info in message header (Yes) or body (No).

db_cachesize.description: Non-zero integer for DB cache size in Mbytes. Zero uses DB default.

db_log_autoremove.description: Boolean indicating whether auto-removing of logs should be enabled (yes) or disabled (no).

terse.description: Boolean indicating if the X-Bogosity header should use the 'terse_format' specification.
